name: Dominara
description: The world the Lady was created to watch over.

description_citations.text: "Lady of Otaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gaea and Fiers create the Lady, who hatches from a giant stone egg heated among lava vents.
timeline.quote: The Lady was hatched from inside a giant stone egg that Fiers placed among lava vents to heat.

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Demon despoilers attack the world and create goblins; with Fiers's help the Lady creates the dwarves.
timeline.quote: With the help of Fiers, the Lady then created the dwarves to defend her world.

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Lady and dwarves defeat the evil but she is gravely injured; Gaea heals her and Fiers encases her in half her egg.
timeline.quote: The Lady and the dwarves defeat the evil, but the Lady is grievously injured in the process.

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The gods entrust the Lady's protection to Themis, Gardill and Balthor Stoneface with a prophecy of three summonings.
timeline.quote: entrust the protection of the Lady to the three dwarves, Themis, Gardill, and Balthor Stoneface

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
